arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_transactions_march_2019 FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND date >= '2019-03-01' AND date < '2019-04-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions of type Online Transaction dated in March 2019.
assumptions: March 2019 is 2019-03-01 up to but not including 2019-04-01, within the data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
